The existence of peak solutions and the concentration phenomenon of solutions has been
extensively studied for the semiclassical Shr¨odinger equation (1.3), see for instance [1, 2, 8,
9, 20] for part of results in this direction. In particular, positive solutions with prescribed
number of peaks to nonlinear Schr¨odinger equations were obtained in [14] by using the
well-known Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction scheme. This argument was later generalized in
[5] to study nonlinear Schr¨odinger equations with vanishing potentials. However, it seems
no multi-peaks solution has been found for problem (1.6) in literatures.
